experiment.title: SCE Experiment 1.3 — Detective Probe: Detect IMDS Weakening via ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions
experiment.description: Validates that the detective controls for Attack Node 1.2 (T1578 — Modify Cloud Compute Infrastructure) correctly detect when an adversary downgrades IMDS protection on a banking-platform EC2 instance by setting HttpTokens=optional and HttpPutResponseHopLimit=2. The experiment provisions a clean EC2 instance with IMDSv2 enforced as the steady state, executes the attack API call scoped to that instance, and then verifies three detection signals within a 30-minute SLA: (A) CloudTrail captures the ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions event in CloudWatch Logs, (B) the EventBridge rule matching that API call registers at least one invocation, and (C) the CloudWatch metric-filter alarm transitions to ALARM state. All infrastructure is created and destroyed by the experiment via CloudFormation.

steady-state-hypothesis.title: EC2 instance exists with IMDSv2 enforced, CloudTrail trail is active, and EventBridge rule is ENABLED — no prior ModifyInstanceMetadataOptions alarm is firing
